require 'runar'

class RbMixed < Runar::SmartContract
  def initialize
    super()
  end

  runar_public c: Boolean
  def unlock(c)
    assert _h(c)
  end

  private

  params c: Boolean
  def _h(c)
    if c
      return 1
    end
    true
  end
end
